title: Counselling Services
headline: Counseling Services at XLRI Delhi-NCR
intro: At XLRI Delhi-NCR, we are committed to the holistic well-being of our students and offer comprehensive counseling support through two complementary channels: internal and external.

channels.label: On campus, in person
channels.title: Internal Counseling Services
channels.text: Our in-house professional counselor provides confidential, one-on-one support to students dealing with a range of concerns, including stress, anxiety, academic pressure, relationship difficulties, adjustment challenges, self-esteem issues, and personal decision-making. Guided by XLRI’s Jesuit ethos of cura personalis (care for the whole person), the internal counseling service offers a safe and supportive space where students can explore their emotions, strengthen resilience, enhance emotional intelligence, and develop healthier ways of coping and growing.

channels.label: Online, anytime
channels.title: External Counseling Support – YourDOST
channels.text: To ensure wider access and flexibility, XLRI has partnered with YourDOST, a nationally recognized online counseling and mental-wellness platform. Through YourDOST, students can access anonymous, 24/7 professional support, including chat-based counseling, scheduled video/phone sessions, and a range of mental health resources. This channel allows students to seek help privately and at their convenience from qualified mental health professionals outside the institute.

closing: Together, these two channels ensure that every student at XLRI can find the right kind of support—whether they prefer in-person guidance within the campus community or flexible online counseling accessible anytime, anywhere. At XLRI, seeking support is viewed as a sign of strength, and our counseling services are here to walk with students as they navigate the challenges and opportunities of their academic journey.
quote: At XLRI, seeking support is viewed as a sign of strength.

notice.title: If you need help right now
notice.text: If you are in distress or feel unsafe, please don’t wait — reach out straight away.
